We are fully equipped with the latest equipment necessary to provide these specialized services. Transmission Lines We provide testing & commissioning services and have the most modern test equipment's to carry out the electrical equipment tests at site for HV and LV transmission lines. CT Analyzer We provide complete on-field instrument transformer (CTs) testing services. With our portable test kit (CT ANALYZER), the client can test all types of CTs. Circuit Breaker Testing We provide complete on-field testing of C.Bs of all types up to 500 kV. With our all in one portable test set CIBANO 500", we can test all the parameters or C.Bs. Voltage Transformers We provide instrument transformer testing services for voltage transformers (PTs, VTs, CVTs) FAT/SAT acceptance testing, W.R, I.R, Ratio, Polarity, C & D.F, Partial discharge testing. High Voltage (HV) Cables We provide complete on-field high voltage testing services through our portable test unit such as high voltage testing services for GIS (up-to 220kV), switchgear, transformers, power cables rated up to 132kV. Industrial Solutions Power Grid Solutions We provide complete testing and commissioning solution of all Power stations and Grid stations at national and international level as per NTDC specifications as well as IEEE/IEC standards.
